scope: Site copy verified against public v1.40.0 on October 21, 2026: Glance as a card floating over the page (F34, #1007, #1008) on /features/glance, its Support guide, the /features tile and pop-up, the homepage Glance card and demo, and the Arc alternative page, which also point to Split View (F53, two panes) for side by side. The capture is docs/website-captures-v1.40.0.json. Glance was hand-checked in Windows and Linux VMs from source before #1008 (recorded on #1007); the copy makes no platform-specific claim. Also the homepage’s first screen (October 21, 2026): its handwritten note, its lead and the floating Island window’s text alternative, recorded against the Auto-hide float style of v1.40.0.

floatingGlance.qualification: Since v1.40.0 the Glance tab opens as a card floating over the active page (default frame min(1100 px, 80%) of the page area, centered 16 px below the Island band). The header (GLANCE, Back, Reload, the site, Change, Open as tab, Keep as split, Move or resize, Close Glance) moves the card; an 8 px ring resizes it (360 × 280 minimum); a double-click on the header or Enter on Move or resize resets it; the arrow keys on Move or resize move it 16 px. Escape closes it only from the card’s chrome. A tab switch closes it. The page behind stays usable (F34-10).

splitView.qualification: Keep as split makes a fresh two-pane Split View (50/50, main page first). Split View shows two panes only in v1.40.0.

glanceQuiet.qualification: Choosing a quiet tab for Glance wakes (reloads) it; a visible Glance tab is never quieted (F34-1).

glanceFrame.qualification: Only the card’s frame is remembered, as device-local fractions (glanceFrame); the open Glance itself is never written to session.json or synced.

glancePicker.qualification: The picker lists tabs of the current window and local profile only (⌘⇧G or Ctrl+Shift+G, View → Open Glance…).

floatStyle.qualification: Auto-hide the Island is opt-in and device-local (islandAutoHide defaults to false; Settings → General, the View menu, ⌘⌥B or Ctrl+Alt+B). With it on, the page fills the window and, since v1.40.0, the revealed Island floats over the page by default (islandAutoHideStyle 'float'). While it floats it comes back only from the window’s top edge (or ⌘L, Ctrl+L) and hides once the pointer moves into the page; the window buttons hide and come back with it on macOS, Windows and Linux (#1003, floatViewsShown), so nothing of Blanc’s stays drawn over the page; only an invisible 6 px drag band remains. On native Wayland the band above a floating window can’t reveal it. Never imply Blanc hides the Island out of the box.

islandFacts.qualification: Public v1.40.0: tabs, search and commands are reached from the one Island pill (the tab dots, the address field and slash commands in its panel).

platformsAndBlocking.qualification: Public v1.40.0 ships free for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (x64) and 64-bit Linux as an AppImage; desktop only. adblockEnabled defaults to true, so Blanc Blocker is on from the first launch; blocking reduces known ads and tracking, not all of it.
